rules.name: RWX or Executable Memory Allocation in System Process

false_positive_disproval.description: DETERMINISTIC: Checked by sieve_deterministic.py. If deterministic layer flagged TRAMPOLINE, it is process injection. If deterministic layer flagged JIT_PADDING or CFG, it is benign.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF deterministic classification is JIT_PADDING OR CFG THEN DISPROVE.

false_positive_disproval.description: Verify if a dropper artifact exists in volatile space (/tmp, /dev/shm). If dynamic investigation indicates dropper executions correlation, FAIL to disprove.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF dynamic investigation reveals dropper artifacts THEN FAIL_TO_DISPROVE.

mitre_mapping.procedure: Process Injection: RWX shellcode in system process

false_positive_disproval.description: Check if the process name truncation is due to the 15-character TASK_COMM_LEN limit in the Linux kernel (e.g. systemd-resolve -> systemd-resolv).
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF Process name matches a known baseline process truncated at exactly 15 characters THEN DISPROVE.

rules.name: Staging Archive in Temporary or Volatile Directory

false_positive_disproval.description: Check if the archive is an administrative backup or benign download. If telemetry lacks clear metadata, disproval is INCONUSIVE.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF archive matches system backup patterns THEN DISPROVE.

false_positive_disproval.description: Check if script is run by package manager or administrative cron updates.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF Script belongs to legitimate system updates or apt/dpkg context THEN DISPROVE.

false_positive_disproval.description: Verify if binary belongs to legitimate compiler outputs, package installers, or local tests.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF Binary is recognized developer test output THEN DISPROVE.

false_positive_disproval.description: Check if deletion command belongs to legitimate cleanups or system log rotations.
false_positive_disproval.disproval_logic: IF performed during routine logrotate or sys admin cleaning THEN DISPROVE.
